candidates.description: This vector represents Thai vowel signs and diacritics combined with consonant characters.
This vector represents subword tokens and fragments commonly found in Thai text processing.
This vector represents quantitative adjectives and determiners in Thai indicating amounts, numbers, and distribution.
This vector activates for isolated lowercase Greek letters, individual metric units, and fragments of non-English text appearing as isolated noise tokens.
These tokens represent a noisy mixture of multilingual fragments and abbreviations without a single cohesive semantic theme.
This vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant 'บ' (bo baimai) and its common syllabic combinations.
This vector represents numerical values, counts, or measurements, predominantly clustered around specific quantities like 240.
This vector activates for common sub-word tokens and character sequences across multiple written languages, particularly in Southeast Asian scripts.
These tokens are a collection of diverse alphabetical characters and text fragments from multiple languages and writing systems.
This feature vector represents the Thai consonant 'ก' (ko kai) and its various diacritic, vowel, and Latin script co-occurrences.
